2.content:
claude.md — Consent Form (Agent Workflow, 208427015)

Purpose: agent-facing intake for Quest Health & Wellness screening consent. Agent captures caller name/company/preferred contact method/preferred language, then either sends a digital consent link (Email/Text) or reads the consent aloud (Voice).

Node map: 1 Intake -> 17 dictionary/resolver -> 6 link builder -> 7 route by consent_preference -> 8 Text / 9 Email / 10 Voice deflect -> 11 Voice Script Consent -> 12 Complete Consent. 13/15/16/14/18/19 verify the participant's digital consent came back (Connected Object 1197, get_session_data).

Data dictionary: company_score (19 values, node 1 "Company" select) -> consent_en/consent_es/client name/client ID via node 17's dictionary (mirrored in node 6's clientData, name/ID only). consent_language ("English"/"Spanish", node 1) selects which text renders and is forwarded to the Customer tree via the zv_consent_language URL parameter (node 6).

External systems: Connected Object 1197 (get_session_data, http) reads the Customer tree's session back by session_id.

Known gaps: 3 of 18 clients (State of Tennessee / partners_for_health_consent, Rock and Roll Hall of Fame / the combined "solutions_program..." key, State of Georgia / shbp_2020) have no Spanish translation on file -- Spanish selection silently falls back to English for these. The dictionary key solutions_program_authorization_for_release_of_health_screening_results__rock_and_roll_hall_of_fame matches neither of its two original dropdown score values -- pre-existing, not touched by this CR. Rachel Hardin's 8/20/2026 spreadsheet also introduced a ~400-client roster mapped to 12 shared templates; only the language feature was built this pass, the roster expansion was explicitly deferred by Brent. parker_hannifin_2026_myguide (added 8/31) has no consent_es -- Spanish falls back to English -- and an empty client ID pending from Quest; healthyquest consent_es is one revision behind its 2026 English text.

Changelog

  • 2026-08-20 -- Added Preferred Language field (node 1); dictionary (node 17) and clientData (node 6) now carry consent_en/consent_es per client for 14 of 18 clients, sourced from Rachel A. Hardin's "Consents for Zingtree 2.xlsx" (Choose Healthy Life and Healthwise/Crown consent text updated to her latest version per Brent's confirmation; the other templates were content-identical to what was live, just reformatted). Retired the "Cigna Consent Spanish 2020" dropdown entry -- folded into a single "cigna_consent" key, language now chosen via the new field. Node 11 (Voice Script Consent) now displays the chosen language. Node 6's link now forwards zv_consent_language.
  • 2026-08-31 -- (1) healthyquest_bfw_hipaa_authorization_08292025 consent_en (node 17) updated to the approved 2026 BFW HIPAA Authorization (Mike Marks email 8/29/2026): Priority Health + Kaiser added to claims administrators, "smoking cessation" -> "nicotine cessation", formatting fixes; consent_es left on prior revision (no updated Spanish from Quest). (2) Added "Parker Hannifin 2026 MyGuide" (score parker_hannifin_2026_myguide) to the node 1 Company dropdown, node 17 dictionary (full Unum disclosure attestation text, Rachel A. Hardin email 8/21/2026), and node 6 clientData (client ID pending from Quest). English only.
  • 2026-09-01 -- HealthyQuest optional research consent updated to the approved 2026 version (Mike Marks email 9/1/2026): the User tree's node 3 now captures two required selections (research_data_consent, research_samples_consent) plus research_signature instead of the old is_caller_optional_consent_received checkbox. Node 19 here now checks len(actions.get_session_data.research_data_consent) >= 1 (participant responded -- DO or DO NOT) instead of requiring the old checkbox to be checked, since declining the optional research is a valid completion. Flag for Quest sign-off: previously the flow would not complete unless the optional consent was checked.
